statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-11824 is a heap buffer overflow in fts5ChunkIterate() in the SQLite FTS5 extension, fixed upstream in SQLite 3.53.2. Debian fixed it for trixie in sqlite3 3.46.1-7+deb13u2, which backports the upstream fix: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-11824. This owner's first build based on 3.46.1-7+deb13u2 is the fixed version, and its package changelog records the Debian security update for CVE-2026-11824. Earlier builds based on 3.46.1-7+deb13u1 do not carry the fix.
